passages.excerpt_preview: The essay is evidence of a late prison position on religion and reason; it is not a complete account of every earlier belief.
He says he had examined the question through study and reflection, rejects reliance on prayer in the face of execution, and treats belief as a proposition to be tested rather than inherited.
ritten in prison in 1930, the essay answers the charge that vanity caused Bhagat Singh’s atheism.
